replay.order: streamed in dataset order, no shuffling

midtrained.content: every SDF document plus shared replay documents up to the SDF token total, interleaved by cumulative-token balancing (emit from the stream with fewer tokens so far, ties to the SDF stream)

control.content: the same interleave with each SDF document replaced by a replay excerpt of identical token length

instruction_tuning.packing: greedy next-fit of whole conversations, conversations longer than the window dropped
